text: First up, our environment wrap, and it's a beauty. More Queensland households are jumping on the rooftop solar bandwagon this spring, with panels going up on roofs from Cairns right down to the border. It's one of those quiet good news stories that just keeps rolling along in the background.

speaker: charlie
text: Yeah and it makes sense too, we get more sunshine hours than just about anywhere, so may as well cash in on it. Meanwhile out on the reef, the coral spawning season has kicked off and marine scientists are chuffed with what they're seeing on some of the healthier patches.

speaker: alice
text: It's basically the reef's version of a big family reunion, all happening under the moonlight out on the water. Small wins like that add up, and it's nice to hear some hopeful news out of the reef for a change.
